initialize_parameters_sharded: initialize model parameters sharded across a JAX mesh using uninitialized parameter placeholders
create_ConstrainSharding_layer: create a Penzai layer that constrains the sharding of a tree of arrays via explicit sharding specification
create_ConstrainShardingByName_layer: create a Penzai layer that constrains sharding of NamedArrays by mapping axis names to mesh names
run_name_to_name_sharding: run name-to-name sharding to map array axis names to JAX mesh axis shardings
run_name_to_name_device_put: run name-to-name device put to move arrays to devices with sharding constraints applied by axis name
